title: Sideload Mirroring Quota Sentinel and Tenant-Isolated Sampling Pipeline
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: We need a safe, low-cost way to route a controlled percentage of live production requests to candidate model variants for non-impactful evaluation (shadow runs) while guaranteeing tenant isolation and strict spend caps. Goals: (1) deterministically sample traffic with tenant-aware quotas, (2) mirror requests without affecting latency or downstream chargebacks, (3) stop shadowing automatically when cost or error thresholds are exceeded, and (4) provide observability and audit trails for each mirror pipeline. This ticket implements a Sideload Mirroring Quota Sentinel: a lightweight orchestration layer that coordinates sampling decisions, enforces tenant budgets, and applies adaptive dampening on mirrored traffic to meet latency and spend SLOs.
activity: 2026-03-01: Ticket created; initial design sketch attached. Discussed tenant budget model in weekly infra sync.
2026-03-03: Spike - implemented PoC sampler in the edge sidecar (branch: feat/sideload-sampler). Observed <1ms p95 added latency in local smoke tests.
2026-03-05: Design review with PM and Security. Decided to record mirrored request IDs and tenant tags but not payloads by default; payload capture requires a separate opt-in flow and audit logging.
2026-03-07: Integrated basic quota store backed by Redis with per-tenant counters and soft/hard thresholds. Edge started returning mirror token headers for accepted sideloads.

2026-03-10: Cost sentinel prototype added: will mark tenants as "budget-exhausted" when 95% of monthly mirror spend is reached; automatically reduces sampling rate exponentially until budget replenishes.

2026-03-12: Ran a controlled ramp to 2% replica traffic for internal dogfood tenants. Observed higher error rate on one variant; sentinel triggered auto-damp to 0.2% and opened a P0 investigation ticket for the model team.
2026-03-13: Preparing PR for integration tests and adding end-to-end dashboards. Planning canary rollout to 10 internal tenants next week.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic sampling implemented at edge with tenant scoping and seed-based replayability.
Per-tenant quota enforcement that prevents mirrored spend from exceeding configured monthly budgets.
Automatic sampling rate reduction policy when spend or error thresholds are breached; automatic re-expansion when metrics are healthy.
Mirror routing must be non-blocking for production responses and add <2ms p95 latency overhead for the critical path.
Dashboards for mirrored token throughput, spend burn-rate, error delta (candidate vs baseline), and sentinel actions.
Audit trail entries for every mirrored request include tenant_id, mirror_token, timestamp, and sampling_decision.
testing_plan: Unit tests for sampling algorithm determinism and rate adjustments.
Integration test that simulates tenant budget exhaustion and verifies sentinel reduces sampling and emits events.
Chaos test where candidate model returns increased 5xxs; verify sentinel detects error-delta and throttles mirroring.
Load test to validate production latency overhead at 10k rps with 2% mirroring enabled.
E2E smoke with internal tenants followed by a 10-tenant canary expansion.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal): enable for 3 internal tenants at 0.5% for 48h, monitor metrics.
Phase 2 (dogfood): expand to 10 internal tenants at 2% for 72h with manual oversight.
Phase 3 (pilot customers): enable for 5 willing customers at 0.1% with consent and billing shield.
Phase 4 (general availability): open to opt-in for all tenants with UI controls in Console and default off.
fallback_and_rollback: If sentinel detects sustained cost burn-rate > 120% forecast or error-delta > 2x baseline for >15m, immediately reduce sampling to 0.1% and alert on-call.
If production latency for p95 increases > 10ms vs baseline, suspend mirroring at the gateway and fail open for user responses.
Rollback path: revert sidecar config and redeploy mirror-controller to previous image. Run smoke tests before re-enabling.
cost_model: Primary control is sampling rate per tenant with exponential backoff when spend approaches configured thresholds. Mirrored runs are charged to a separate internal chargeback ledger; sentinel enforces per-tenant hard caps and sends webhook alerts when soft thresholds are crossed. We also implement prefix KV caching on the mirrored pipeline to avoid double-compute for identical prefixes and use cached responses for heavy conversational loops.
metrics_and_alerts: mirroring.spend_burn_rate - % of monthly allocated mirror budget
mirroring.sampling_rate - current effective sampling per tenant
